c2_dependency.authority_design: record authority is an INJECTED VERIFIER FUNCTION invoked on the current record bytes at EVERY build and verify (accepted only as {:verified true :digest <64-hex>} matching the record's digest), plus an independent re-derivation of the record's :record/digest from the current bytes before any verifier result is trusted — a mutated record carrying an old digest and an echoing verifier refuses :record-body-digest-mismatch with the verifier never consulted. Caller-supplied status maps are never accepted.
